64 Oozumou 2.name: 64 Oozumou 2
64 Oozumou 2.summary: 64 Oozumou 2 is a sumo wrestling game for the Nintendo 64, which was only released in Japan in 1999. It is the sequel to the game 64 Oozumou. Like its predecessor, the gameplay simulates various aspects of a sumo wrestlers life and training cycle.
